tasks.title: Set up repository and project structure
tasks.description: Create the GitHub repository, folders and base HTML files.
userStories: As a developer, I want a clean structure so that the project is easy to maintain.

tasks.title: Design the UI with Tailwind CSS
tasks.description: Define colors, typography and the main layout.
userStories: As a user, I want a clear interface so that I can find information quickly.

tasks.title: Build the project form with validation
tasks.description: Create the form and validate each field in real time.
userStories: As a user, I want clear error messages so that I can fix my input.

tasks.title: Implement the API service
tasks.description: Write the Fetch calls and error handling.
userStories: As a developer, I want a dedicated API module so that calls are reusable.

tasks.title: Render the task list dynamically
tasks.description: Generate cards from the JSON data.
userStories: As a user, I want to see my tasks so that I can follow my work.

tasks.title: Persist data in LocalStorage
tasks.description: Save and reload projects with JSON.stringify and JSON.parse.
userStories: As a user, I want my data saved so that I do not lose it on refresh.

tasks.title: Test, document and deploy
tasks.description: Final tests, README and Vercel deployment.
userStories: As a teacher, I want a documented deployed project so that I can evaluate it.
